title: I Made a Cookie Clicker Game in Just 10 Minutes with AI
author: nephelle
selftext:
Hey everyone!

Nostalgic for the old browser games, I challenged myself to make a cookie clicker game in just 10 minutes using AI. 

The tool is [Rosebud AI Gamemaker](https://rosebud.ai) (currently in alpha via waitlist). The 2D template is based on Phaser.js.

Here are the main steps I went through:

1. Started by giving initial prompt: "create a simple cookie clicker game that uses Phaser logo as a cookie".
2. Had to do a bit of troubleshooting because of gravity.
3. Implemented logo shaking on each click.
4. Generated and integrated AI-generated rose asset via "Assets" tab (Cartoony Items model) to replace the standard Phaser logo. It automatically removes background which is the best.
5. Tweaked the rose sprite to get the right size.
6. Added a feature where the rose bouquet grows and bounces with every 100 clicks.
7. Switched it up from bouncing to spinning because bouncing was too mild because of the shaking it is doing on each click.
8. Published and shared the game. 

Here's the full video to see the process in action: 

https://reddit.com/link/14w0cn5/video/8tpfi9qq96bb1/player

What are the other games from the good ol' days you miss? Ever wanted to start a custom collection since it is so easy now with AI code gen?
